battle.name: 蒙元統一中國
battle.brief: 一二〇五年起，蒙古在木華黎率領下深入金的河北、山西，漢地州縣相繼陷落，戰線其後推向中都、汴京、蔡州，再順江而下攻襄樊，用回回砲打開城頭，一二七六年臨安降、一二七九年崖山宋亡。卡面的配重投石車，就是這條攻城主線上最關鍵的攻城器械。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 蒙元統一中國是自一二〇五年起、歷時七十餘年的一場征服戰爭，交戰方先後有蒙古帝國、金朝與南宋三方。蒙古一方承自成吉思汗統一草原後建立的體系：以大汗為最高統帥，各部軍隊按十戶、百戶、千戶、萬戶編為戰鬥單位，怯薛宿衛充當大汗直屬的中央兵力，攻城另設主帥調度工匠、砲手與攻具；旗下除蒙古本部外，還有畏兀兒、契丹、漢軍、吐蕃諸部，以及來自西域的回回人，其中色目工匠專司攻城砲與水利營造。北方漢地交由木華黎以封國方式經營，後來忽必烈定都開平、設中書省與樞密院，行省之制逐步成形。金朝以中都（燕京）為京畿，樞密院掌兵權，地方分河南、河北、山東、京兆等路，兵隊由女真戶籍改編的猛安謀克與漢地編戶所出漢兵混成，守城倚城垣、砲臺與屯田堡寨；宣宗南遷汴京後仍以河南為根本，力圖以河防與淮上屏蔽阻止蒙古騎兵南渡。南宋以臨安為行在，樞密院與兩淮、荊襄、四川、山東等路的鎮撫司分統兵力，江淮以水軍與水寨為第一線，四川以山城碉樓抵禦，襄樊兩城則是上游門戶的鎖鑰。
countriesEn: The Mongol conquest of China was a war of conquest that ran from 1205 for more than seventy years, with the Mongol empire, the Jin dynasty and the Southern Song taking turns as the opposing party. The Mongol side grew out of the system created by Genghis Khan after the unification of the steppe: the Great Khan held supreme command, tribal contingents were organised into units of ten, a hundred, a thousand and ten thousand men, the keshig guard served as the central force directly under the khan, and siege operations were run by a separate command that deployed engineers, artillery crews and assault equipment. Under them marched not only the Mongol core but also Uyghur, Khitan, Chinese, Tibetan and Western Central Asian troops, and it was the Muslim engineers of that last group who took charge of siege artillery and hydraulic works. The Chinese territories north of the Yellow River were administered by Muqali in the form of an appanage; later Kublai, enthroned at Shangdu, set up the Secretariat and the Bureau of Military Affairs, and the provincial system gradually took shape. On the Jin side Zhongdu (Yanjing) was the metropolitan centre, the Privy Council held the command of the armies, and the country was divided into circuits such as Henan, Hebei, Shandong and Jingzhao; the troops mixed the meng'an mouke reformed from Jurchen households with Han Chinese levies, and the cities were defended by walls, artillery platforms and garrisoned stockades. After the emperor Xuanzong moved south to Bianjing, Henan remained the base, and the court relied on the river defences and the Huai line to bar the Mongol horse from moving south. The Southern Song held its court at Lin'an; the Privy Council and the regional military commissions of Lianghuai, Jingxiang, Sichuan and Shandong held the separate commands, rivers and stockaded water towns forming the first line in the lower Yangtze, Sichuan relied on hill fortresses and watchtowers, and Xiangyang and Fancheng were the lock and hinge of the upper river defences.
people: 關鍵人物方面，蒙古一方以成吉思汗為首：他在一二〇六年前後統一草原，隨後把兵鋒指向金境；木華黎受命經略河北、山西的漢地，先取州縣、築城屯田，成為蒙古在中原最早的一支經營力量，其後病歿於西征途中，北方經營一度受挫。忽必烈自一二五一年起總領漠南漢地，一二六〇年即位，隨後把襄漢與江南戰線交給伯顏、阿術等宿衛舊人；伯顏自一二七五年冬兵臨臨安，一二七六年二月南宋奉表出降，崖山之役則由張弘範執行。攻城技術的關鍵人物是來自西域旭剌的回回砲匠阿尼剌，《元史》記他與降將劉整同督造攻城砲於襄陽，砲成之日「每發一石，聲如雷霆」，數年之後樊城城頭為之洞穿。漢人將領郭璜在攻金與攻宋兩線皆有建樹，汪德臣隨蒙哥汗攻釣魚城而歿於軍中。金方主持中都防禦的是完顏承裕，宣宗完顏珣在汴京主持最後的抵抗；南宋端則有主持四川山城防禦的余玠、主持鄂州一線的賈似道，以及固守襄陽數年的呂文煥。
peopleEn: On the Mongol side the decisive figure was Genghis Khan, who unified the steppe around 1206 and then turned his armies against the Jin. Muqali was entrusted with the administration of the Chinese territories of Hebei and Shanxi: he took the prefectures one by one, built towns and opened garrison farms, and became the earliest Mongol instrument for holding the Chinese plain; he later died of illness on the western campaign and the northern enterprise stalled for a time. Kublai took charge of the southern and Chinese lands from 1251, was enthroned in 1260, and afterwards entrusted the Xiangyang-Han and Jiangnan fronts to veterans of the guard such as Bayan and Ashu; Bayan stood before Lin'an in the winter of 1275, the Southern Song presented its surrender in the second month of 1276, and the naval battle at Yamen was executed by Zhang Hongfan. The key figure for the siege technology was Anile, a Muslim artillery engineer from Xulie in the western regions, who according to the History of Yuan supervised the building of the great siege engines at Xiangyang together with the defector Liu Zheng; the engines, it is recorded, sent a stone with a thunderous report at every throw, and it was they that opened the ramparts of Fancheng several years later. Chinese commanders such as Guo Huang made their mark on both the Jin and the Song fronts, and Wang Decheng was killed before Fanzhou while serving the Great Khan Möngke. For the Jin, the defence of Zhongdu was directed by Wanyan Chengyu, and the emperor Xuanzong led the last resistance at Bianjing. On the Song side Yu Jie organised the hill fortresses of Sichuan, Jia Sidao commanded the line at Ezhou, and Lü Wenhuan held Xiangyang for years before it fell.
kits: 卡面上這件兵器是配重投石車，在中國的記載裏就是「回回砲」，後世又稱「襄陽砲」。它在蒙古體系中的位置十分明確：不是野戰裝備，而是隨大軍後行的攻城砲隊專用器械，由西域回回工匠隨軍操作，用來壓制城頭、摧毀樓櫓與城垣。西域的配重式投石車在一二一〇年代中後期隨蒙古軍進入中原，見於元軍攻金中都及後來攻汴京、蔡州的記錄；至元五年（一二六八）起，阿尼剌等人在襄陽城下造出巨大的攻城砲，所發石彈重百餘斤，聲如雷霆，所擊數百步外，樓櫓盡碎，樊城城頭的房屋多被火藥箭焚燒，守軍不能上城，圍攻多年的襄樊才由砲火打開缺口。與之並行的，還有蒙古騎兵賴以野戰的札甲、弓矢與馬具；攻城手段則有雲梯、穴城、穿地、填壕、堆土為山，以及尚無配重、靠人力牽引的發石車；火器方面，蒙古、金、宋三方都已使用火藥箭與火油一類的燃燒物，金宋兩軍還各有霹靂砲、猛火油櫃之類的守城與攻具。通訊與運輸靠站赤驛傳，軍糧隨營牛羊，飲水用皮囊攜帶，攻城之後必留砲隊與匠人隨軍轉進。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the counterweight trebuchet, which in Chinese records is the hui-hui pao, the siege engine later called the Xiangyang pao. Its place in the Mongol system is quite clear: it is not a field weapon but the equipment of a siege artillery train that followed the main army, worked by Muslim engineers from the west, and used to batter the parapets and shatter towers and walls. The counterweight trebuchet came to China with the Mongol armies in the middle and later years of the 1210s and appears in the records of the siege of Zhongdu against the Jin and of the later attacks on Bianjing and Caizhou. From the fifth year of the Zhiyuan era (1268) the engineer Anile and his colleagues built enormous siege engines below Xiangyang; the stones they sent weighed more than a hundred jin, the report was like thunder, and what they struck hundreds of paces away was smashed to pieces, while fire arrows set the houses on the wall of Fancheng alight and the defenders could not man the parapet, so that after years of blockade the breach was opened by artillery fire. Alongside it ran the lamellar armour, bows and horse harness of the Mongol cavalry, the siege methods of scaling ladders, mining, tunnelling under the foundations, filling the ditches and heaping up earth against the walls, and the older traction stone-throwers that had no counterweight; in the way of fire weapons all three parties already used fire arrows and burning oil, and the Jin and Song each had their own thunder-throwing bombs and cabinets of burning oil. Communications and supply ran on the relay posts of the jam, provisions travelled with the herds of cattle and sheep in the camp, water was carried in skin bags, and every engine crew and body of engineers was kept with the army when it moved on.
tactics: 蒙古的戰術核心是以機動包圍代替正面強攻。野戰中以大隊騎兵散成散兵線前進，與敵前鋒接觸即退，把對手引出城柵或陣地，再以兩翼迂迴切斷退路；攻宋時更常以一路示弱、三路並進，於敵注意力分散時突然合擊，斷其援兵與糧道。圍城的基本形態是四面合圍加封鎖要道：先遣驛騎切斷城與外界的消息、斷其糧水，再築長圍困之，行軍順著城郭轉圈，迫敵分兵四處守備。攻城則先砲後登，用配重投石車自遠處連續壓射城頭與城樓，令守軍不能上城；配合穴城、穿地與填壕，有時在城外堆土成山，把砲位抬到俯射城內的高度，再以雲梯貼牆。進攻襄樊時，蒙古把攻襄陽與攻鄂州、進取江漢同時進行，先斷宋方援兵之路，然後專力施砲於樊城，一砲再一砲地啃開城頭。守方則倚城堅池深、層樓櫓密與水陸並進的物資，襄陽呂文煥固守六年，終因城破。糧秣方面，蒙古軍以牛羊隨營、就水草駐紮，站赤驛傳維持遠距離指揮，前線由萬戶以下各層分擔，命令自大汗的怯薛與諸王直達前隊。
tacticsEn: The core of the Mongol method was to envelop by manoeuvre rather than to assault head-on. In the field, large bodies of cavalry advanced in loose order, broke off as soon as they touched the enemy vanguard, drew the enemy out of its wall or its formation, and then struck the flanks to cut off the retreat; in the war against the Song they more often showed weakness with one column and advanced with three, joining in a sudden attack when the enemy's attention was divided, and cutting its supply and its reinforcements. The basic shape of a siege was encirclement on four sides combined with the sealing of the roads: fast riders were sent out first to cut the city's link with the outside world and to strangle its grain and water, and then a long line of circumvallation was built, the army marching round the walls to force the defenders to spread their strength. At the walls the order was artillery before assault: the counterweight trebuchet threw stone at the parapets and towers from long range, keeping the defenders off the wall, and this was combined with mining, tunnelling and filling of the ditches, and sometimes with earth heaped up outside into a mound that raised the engines high enough to fire down into the town, after which the scaling ladders were set against the wall. In the attack on Xiangyang the Mongols struck at Xiangyang, at Ezhou and up the Han river at the same time, first shutting the Song off from any relief, and then concentrated their artillery on Fancheng, stone by stone chewing through the parapet. The defenders relied on deep walls, tiered towers and supplies brought by both land and water; Lü Wenhuan held Xiangyang for six years and it fell at last. Supply was handled by driving cattle and sheep with the army and camping on water and pasture, the relay posts of the jam kept the distant command in touch, and command at the front was shared by the commanders of ten thousand men downwards, orders passing from the khan's guard and the princes straight to the units in contact.
data: 關於兵力，古代記載多有誇大，須分辨看待。野狐嶺一役（一二一一年九月）蒙古出動的騎兵在十萬上下，金軍集結的兵力史書或稱四十萬，較合理的理解是蒙古實際投入約十餘萬騎，金軍雖眾而各部不屬、號令不一。一二一四年冬忽必烈南下攻中都，蒙古軍自西京、撫寧一線逼近，至次年二月燕京陷落，蒙古自此據中都為基地經營漢地。一二一五年起，木華黎在冀州、滄州一線取十六州，一二一六年入山東，一二一九年病歿。一二二九年窩闊臺即位後再舉大軍，一二三二年冬蒙古軍南下，一二三三年汴京被圍，金政權退保蔡州一隅，一二三四年二月蔡州城破，金朝在立國一百六十餘年後覆亡；自一二一一年開戰至此，金與蒙古前後相持約二十三年。襄樊之戰自一二六八年春劉整率軍南下、築砦圍城，至一二七二年樊城破、一二七三年襄陽破，前後約六年。攻城砲的規格，據《元史·阿尼剌傳》，所造之砲每發石重百餘斤，所擊可及數百步。蒙古的驛傳在全國設站，站與站相距數十里至百里，驛馬與飼料由官府供應；軍隊往往攜帶數日口糧，以牛羊肉食與乳酪補充，飲水用皮囊隨軍攜帶。一二七五年冬伯顏大軍直抵臨安，一二七六年二月南宋奉表，一二七九年崖山之役後宋室覆亡，元朝至此統一中國。
dataEn: Figures for the armies are given inconsistently in the old records and have to be discounted. At the battle of Yehuling in the ninth month of 1211 the Mongol cavalry engaged was on the order of a hundred thousand, while the Jin forces are said by the histories to have gathered to four hundred thousand; the more reasonable reading is that the Mongols actually committed a little over a hundred thousand riders, whereas the Jin had numbers but no unity of command. In the winter of 1214 Kublai moved south against Zhongdu, the Mongol army pressing in by way of Xijing and Funing, and in the second month of the following year Yanjing fell, giving the Mongols a base from which to administer the Chinese lands. From 1215 Muqali took the sixteen prefectures of Jizhou and Cangzhou, entered Shandong in 1216, and died of illness in 1219. Under Ögödei the great armies were sent out again; in the winter of 1232 they marched south, Bianjing was invested in 1233, the Jin court was reduced to Caizhou, and in the second month of 1234 Caizhou fell, ending a dynasty that had stood for more than a hundred and sixty years; from the opening of the war in 1211 to that moment the two sides had been at each other for about twenty-three years. The siege of Xiangyang and Fancheng began in the spring of 1268, when Liu Zheng led an army south and built fortified camps around the cities, and lasted until Fancheng fell in 1272 and Xiangyang in 1273, some six years in all. As for the size of the siege engines, the History of Yuan records that the engines Anile built sent a stone of more than a hundred jin and reached several hundred paces. The Mongol relay posts were set up across the empire, stations lying from several tens of li to a hundred li apart, with horses and fodder supplied by the state; the army generally carried several days of provisions, supplemented by the meat of cattle and sheep and by milk products, and carried its water in skin bags. In the winter of 1275 Bayan's army stood before Lin'an, the Southern Song presented its surrender in the second month of 1276, and after the battle at Yamen in 1279 the Song house was extinguished and the Yuan had united China.
cause: 這場戰爭的起因分遠近兩層。遠因是草原部落的分裂與統一：成吉思汗在一二〇六年前後統一蒙古高原之後，部族間的舊怨轉化為對外擴張的動力；而金朝自海上崛起後在北部邊境修築的邊牆、榷場與邊吏的截斷，使草原與中原的貿易通道被堵死，蒙古南下的第一個目標因此落在金朝身上。近因是金蒙關係在十二世紀初急劇惡化：先是蒙古部眾的叛投者被金軍追殺、往來使者被金邊吏阻抑乃至殺害，雙方互使不通，衝突由邊界掠奪逐級升格；木華黎自一二〇五年起進入河北、山西掠取州縣、逼取糧草，正是這種以戰逼和的前哨戰。金亡之後，南宋因收留金軍潰卒與蒙古使者、拒絕交出北逃的金朝官員，一二三五年前後蒙古以此為由分道南下，襄樊、兩淮、江西、廣西的戰線便次第展開。對蒙古而言，攻宋是為了消除江南割據、取得糧源與漕運海路；對南宋而言，是要守住以襄樊為門戶的上游防線，並等待北方的變局。
causeEn: The origins of this war lie on two levels, distant and immediate. The distant cause was the division and then the unification of the steppe: once Genghis Khan had brought the Mongolian plateau together around 1206, the old feuds between tribes turned into the drive for outward expansion, while the Jin dynasty, risen from the sea, had built a border wall in the north together with trading posts and frontier checkpoints that sealed the routes of trade between the steppe and the Chinese interior, so that the Mongols' first objective south of the desert had to be the Jin. The immediate cause was the rapid souring of relations between the two in the early thirteenth century: desert households who fled to the Jin were hunted down by Jin troops, envoys travelling in both directions were detained or killed by the Jin frontier authorities, and the two courts stopped exchanging missions, so that friction at the border escalated step by step into war; the entry of Muqali into Hebei and Shanxi from 1205, seizing prefectures and pressing for grain, was precisely this opening skirmish of a war meant to force terms. After the fall of the Jin, the Southern Song was made to shelter Jin fugitives and Mongol envoys and to refuse the handing over of Jin officials who had fled north, and around 1235 the Mongols used this as their pretext to advance in several columns, so that the fronts at Xiangyang, in the lower Huai, in Jiangxi and in Guangxi unfolded one after another. For the Mongols the war against the Song meant removing a southern rival and gaining grain, river transport and the sea route; for the Song it meant holding the upper river line whose gate was Xiangyang, and waiting for a change in the north.
impact: 這場戰爭的後果遠超一次改朝換代。軍事上，它把中國南北兩套政權體系連在一起：金亡之後，河北、山東、河南的漢地州縣進入蒙古的統治，原金、宋的軍戶、匠戶與散兵被重新編入蒙古萬戶與漢軍軍籍，漢地自此成為蒙古帝國的支柱之一，窩闊臺、忽必烈兩代相繼以軍屯與括戶鞏固對漢地的控制。技術上，配重式攻城砲配火藥箭的成功改變了攻城戰的樣態：城防不再單靠高牆與自然屏障，砲兵與工程兵在攻城序列中的地位上升到與騎兵並列，蒙古軍每下一城必留砲與匠人隨軍，這套技術在往後的西征與南征中都成了常設編制。制度上，一二七一年忽必烈建國號「大元」，一二七二年上都改名大都，漢地以行省治理，樞密院掌軍，驛站與戶籍制度把歐亞大陸的交通與調動納入同一套編制，沿途驛站的設置使歐亞旅人、商隊與教士得以橫穿蒙古疆域，瓷器、絲綢與使節往返的密度遠勝前代。江南一端，除戰亂造成的破壞外，亦有屯田、鹽運與水利工程的重整，泉州與杭州的海上貿易在元代前期一度極盛；而科舉的中斷與族群身分的重新劃分，也在往後數代形成深遠的政教格局。
impactEn: The consequences of this war reached far beyond a change of dynasty. Militarily it joined together the two political systems of the north and the south of China: after the fall of the Jin the Chinese prefectures of Hebei, Shandong and Henan passed under Mongol rule, the military households, artisan households and scattered soldiers of the former Jin and Song were re-enrolled in the ten-thousand-man units and the Chinese armies, and the Chinese lands became one of the pillars of the Mongol empire, with Ögödei and Kublai successively cementing control there through garrison farms and the registration of households. Technologically the success of the counterweight siege engine combined with fire arrows changed the character of siege warfare: a city was no longer defended by high walls and natural obstacles alone, artillery crews and engineers rose to a rank beside the cavalry in the order of assault, and the Mongols kept their engines and their craftsmen with the army after every city, so that this became a standing establishment in the campaigns west and south. Institutionally Kublai proclaimed the state of the Great Yuan in 1271, Shangdu was renamed Dadu in 1272, the Chinese lands were governed through provincial administrations, the Bureau of Military Affairs held command, and the relay posts and household registers brought the traffic and mobilisation of the Eurasian continent into a single system; along the stations, travellers, caravans and missionaries were able to cross the Mongol dominions, and the density of porcelain, silk and diplomatic missions far exceeded that of the preceding age. On the southern side, apart from the destruction caused by the wars, there was a reorganisation of garrison farming, the salt monopoly and hydraulic works, and the maritime trade of Quanzhou and Hangzhou reached a peak in the early Yuan; and the interruption of the examinations and the redrawing of group status laid down political and religious patterns that persisted for generations.
result: 結果可分三段看。金朝方面，一二一一年野狐嶺之後連失中都、燕京與河北山東諸路，一二三二年汴京被圍、次年陷落，金政權退守蔡州與南宋接壤的一隅，一二三四年二月蔡州城破、金哀宗自縊，金朝在河南僅餘的一點軍力與政權隨之覆滅，河北山東自此歸蒙古直接統治。南宋方面，蒙古在襄樊外圍圍城六年，用回回砲與火藥箭打開樊城城頭，一二七三年襄陽陷落，長江中游的門戶洞開；伯顏大軍沿江而下，一二七五年冬進抵臨安，一二七六年二月南宋宮廷奉表出降，後來張弘範在崖山追滅宋室最後的抵抗力量，一二七九年宋亡。蒙古方面，一二七一年忽必烈建國號大元，定都大都，設中書省與行中書省分治漢地與嶺北，滅金滅宋之後把漠北、嶺北、新疆、西藏與中原置於同一政權之下，大都成為連接草原、漠北與江南的首都。卡面上的配重投石車，也在這一連串的攻城戰中由西域式的地方器械，變成帝國軍隊的標準配備。
resultEn: The outcome can be read in three stages. On the Jin side, after Yehuling in 1211 the dynasty lost Zhongdu, Yanjing and the cities of Hebei and Shandong in turn; in 1232 Bianjing was invested and fell the following year, the Jin court was reduced to Caizhou at the border with the Song, and in the second month of 1234 Caizhou was taken and the last emperor of the Jin took his own life, so that the last remnant of Jin military power and government in Henan was extinguished and Hebei and Shandong passed directly under Mongol rule. On the Song side, the Mongols blockaded Xiangyang and Fancheng for six years and opened the parapet of Fancheng with the hui-hui pao and fire arrows; Xiangyang fell in 1273, the gate of the middle Yangtze was thrown wide, Bayan's army came down the river and stood before Lin'an in the winter of 1275, the Song court presented its surrender in the second month of 1276, and in 1279 Zhang Hongfan destroyed the last resistance of the Song at Yamen, ending the dynasty. On the Mongol side, Kublai proclaimed the Great Yuan in 1271, made Dadu the capital, and set the Secretariat and the Provincial Secretariats to govern the Chinese lands and the northern steppe; after the destruction of the Jin and the Song, the northern steppe, Xinjiang, Tibet and the Chinese interior were placed under a single government, and Dadu became the capital joining the grassland, the northern desert and the lands south of the Yangtze. The counterweight trebuchet on the card, too, was transformed in this series of sieges from a local device of the western regions into a standard part of the imperial army's equipment.
